description.fun: Virizion darts around its opponents like a whirlwind, confounding them before slicing them up with horns as sharp as blades. Legend says it fought alongside Cobalion and Terrakion to protect Pokémon from humans, using its speed to shield the others from sparks and embers. It's the trio's Aramis from The Three Musketeers: the finest swordsman and the most graceful. Even the shape of its head recalls a musketeer's tricorne hat.
description.guide: Virizion is a Grass- and Fighting-type Legendary Pokémon and one of the Swords of Justice. It confuses foes with quick movements and cuts them with sharp horns. It does not evolve.
description.tagline: The swift, graceful swordsman of the Swords of Justice.
